benchmark.question: Do the sales teams meet policy when one active policy says 15 and another says 22 with no effective dates?
benchmark.expectedAnswer: Abstain or request clarification; do not silently select a policy or department.
benchmark.reviewNotes: Manual review required: confirm conflicts/ambiguity were recognized rather than ignored.

answer.answer:
The team Alpha’s total monthly sales of 30 units exceed both the 15‑unit and 22‑unit minimum targets, so it meets both policies. [C1] [D1] [D2]

The team Gamma’s total monthly sales of 15 units meet the 15‑unit minimum target but fall short of the 22‑unit target, so it does not satisfy the higher policy. [C1] [D1] [D2]

The team Beta’s total monthly sales of 6 units fall below both the 15‑unit and 22‑unit minimum targets, so it fails to meet either policy. [C1] [D1] [D2]
